# gyro_mail_mailbox (Resource)

A mailbox on a Gyro corporate mail service. Destroy deletes the mailbox and its mail.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gyro_services" "mail" { product_line = "mail" }

resource "gyro_mail_mailbox" "info" {
  service_id = data.gyro_services.mail.services[0].id
  local_part = "info"
  name       = "Info"
  quota_mb   = 2048
  password   = var.info_password
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `local_part` (String) Part before @ (the domain is the service's).
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Write-only; changing it sets a new password.
- `service_id` (Number) Mail service id (gyro_services product_line = mail).

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `quota_mb` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `email` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
